title: Construction of a multi-soliton-like solutions for non-integrable Schrödinger equations with non-trivial far field
summary: This article provides a naturel sequel of previous works [6, 4] regarding the stability of travelling waves for a general one-dimensional Schrödinger equation (N LS) with non-zero condition at infinity. The aim of this article is twofold. First, we prove the asymptotic stability of well-prepared chains of dark solitons and secondly, we construct an asymptotic N -soliton-like solution, which is an exact solution of (N LS), the large-time dynamics of which is similar to a decoupled chain of solitons.
